summary: Frontend-only retest of the Showcase 'Take a look inside' fix. Mobile auto-advance is now WORKING (verified 5 unique image srcs cycled in ~4.5s at 390x844 with no interaction). HOWEVER the primary mobile bug — image fully visible with no crop — is STILL NOT FIXED. On the 390px viewport the showcase preview frame renders 1092px wide (image renders 1090x450 with object-fit:fill), so ~64% of every dashboard image is cut off to the right of the viewport. Desktop (1440x820) works correctly: object-contain 16:9 frame at 1024x576, ~1s auto-advance, hover pauses, unhover resumes. Buy flow, hero image, countdown, sticky bar and /shots/*.webp all pass regression (0 console errors, 0 404s).

ui_bugs.issue: Preview frame overflows viewport: on a 390px viewport the div containing showcase-image renders at 1092px wide, and showcase-image itself renders 1090x450 with object-fit:fill (since sm:object-contain applies only >=640px and the mobile branch is 'block w-full h-auto'). Result: roughly the left 350px is visible and ~740px of every dashboard image is cropped off to the right (see screenshot mobile_showcase_actual.png; e.g. 'FIVE-YEAR DASHBOARD' is chopped mid-word). Document does not horizontally scroll (bodyW=390) because an ancestor clips, but the visual crop is exactly the user-reported bug.

action_items: MOBILE CROP BUG (root cause): The outer wrapper `<div className='grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 sm:gap-6 items-start'>` in Showcase.js is an implicit single-column grid on mobile whose track sizes to min-content. Because the tab list contains 10 `shrink-0` buttons (~1090px wide), the grid track expands to ~1090px, inflating the preview panel to the same width. The tab list's own `overflow-x-auto` is ineffective because its parent (`Reveal` div / `lg:col-span-9`) has no min-width constraint.

SUGGESTED FIX: add `min-w-0` (and/or `w-full`) to the grid children so tracks can shrink below content min-size. Concretely, add `min-w-0 w-full` to the two `<Reveal>` wrappers (lg:col-span-3 and lg:col-span-9), OR on the div itself set `grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12` and add `min-w-0` to children, OR wrap the tabs list with `<div className='min-w-0 max-w-full overflow-hidden'>`. After the fix, verify parentW of showcase-image equals viewport - horizontal padding (~350px) and img renderedW <= 350 on a 390px viewport.
Once cropping is fixed, image should be object-contain (or intrinsic h-auto within a viewport-bounded container) so the whole dashboard screenshot fits.
critical_code_review_comments: Showcase.js line 50-54: grid without explicit `grid-cols-1` on mobile relies on implicit auto tracks — combined with shrink-0 tab buttons this is the source of the mobile overflow. Explicit `grid-cols-1` + `min-w-0` on children is the standard fix.

Showcase.js line 104: 'block w-full h-auto sm:object-contain' — on mobile w-full is fine only if the parent width is viewport-bounded; add min-w-0 upstream. Also 'object-top' has no effect while object-fit is 'fill' on mobile.
Consider `sizes` attribute on to help pick a smaller source on mobile (image natural width 1220-1243px is oversized for 390px viewports).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-advance fix is confirmed working on mobile (verified via 9 samples over ~4.5s captured 5 distinct /shots/*.webp files without any interaction — comparison, custom, balance, salestax, setup). The remaining issue is purely CSS: on 390px viewport the showcase preview frame width is 1092px (grid track sized to min-content of the 10-tab shrink-0 list). After main agent fix, re-check: `document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"showcase-image\"]').getBoundingClientRect().width` should be <= viewport width - side padding on 390px viewport, and the image should not be visually cropped. Playwright note: mobile tap requires `hasTouch: true` browser context; the environment default lacks it, so use `page.click()` instead of `tap()` or use `page.evaluate` to dispatch a click.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the still-present mobile crop: The outer grid in Showcase.js (`grid lg:grid-cols-12`) on the mobile breakpoint acts as an implicit 1-column grid. Grid tracks default to `minmax(auto, 1fr)` — the `auto` minimum equals min-content of the largest child. The tab list is a flex row of 10 `shrink-0` buttons (~1090px total) inside a `overflow-x-auto` div, but that overflow can't apply because the grid track itself is not constrained; it grows to 1090px to satisfy min-content. That inflates the entire section's inner width to ~1090px, which the sibling preview frame then matches at w-full. Since docBody has no horizontal scrollbar (an outer overflow-hidden clips), the extra ~700px of the preview is invisibly cropped. Auto-advance (state-driven setTimeout every 1000ms) is unaffected and works correctly on mobile as designed.
